text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Communist Akel party leader Demetris Christofias says he will run for the presidency in elections in 1998.
- Centre right Democratic Party (Diko) MP Marios Matsakis goes in hiding in the Akamas.
- Fury continues to rumble over the provocative erection of a memorial for EOKA B leader George Grivas.
- Police discover explosives in the sea.
- Akamas activists are removed by police. Diko deputy goes into hiding.
- "Give us more time" unions plead over cost of living allowance talks.
- Diko leader Spyros Kyprianou has new round of contacts with right-wing Disy on the future of their cooperation in government.
- Defence minister says Cyprus will not buy a bullet more than the S-300 missile system from Russia.
- An in-depth debate on the Cyprus issue continues tomorrow at the national council.
- Demonstrators held up British military exercises in the Akamas for hours.
